# Website Support Studio

> Website Support Studio builds and supports practical business websites for small businesses and local service operators. Customers can start with a $500 Founder Website Package, choose a proven website style, launch with mobile-friendly pages and contact paths, and optionally keep ongoing website support after launch.

Website Support Studio is operated by Corriston Consulting, LLC. The service is built around clear ownership, simple website launch paths, customer-owned accounts, and ongoing support for updates, fixes, forms, lead flow, and site improvements.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/): $500 Founder Website Package, sample website styles, Back Office preview, and ownership promise.
- [Services](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/services): What Website Support Studio builds and supports.
- [Pricing](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/pricing): Founder Website Package, ongoing support plans, request credits, and add-ons.
- [Design Systems](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/templates): Website style gallery and sample site starting points.
- [FAQs](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/faqs): Questions about ownership, support, pricing, requests, and what happens after payment.
- [Articles](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/articles): WSS announcements and operational thinking.
- [Contact](https://www.websitesupportstudio.com/contact): Book a call or send project details.
